$comment: FORMA-MOT-010 conformance matrix: each required behavior and the deterministic or browser tests that prove it. tests/motion-gate.test.mjs verifies every referenced test title exists, so this matrix cannot silently rot.

requirements.behavior: Every shipped animated selector is classified under one of the five models; new unclassified animation fails the gate.

tests.title: every shipped animated track is classified under one of the five models
a new animated selector without a model classification fails
assessment, marketing and documentation-site CSS are gated too

requirements.behavior: Unexplained literal durations, easings and implicit easing are rejected; timing comes from the model's tokens.

tests.title: unexplained literal durations, easings and implicit easing are reported
an unexplained literal duration or implicit easing fails even when classified
a token from the wrong model fails (no mass on non-spatial change)

requirements.behavior: Inertial settling orders light < standard < heavy.

tests.title: inertial settling orders light < standard < heavy
weight overrides order inertial timing while gravity timing stays mass independent

requirements.behavior: Gravity timing depends on distance and gravity, never mass.

tests.title: gravity timing follows sqrt(2s / g) and ignores mass
weight overrides order inertial timing while gravity timing stays mass independent

requirements.behavior: Repeated activity uses a named cadence period, linear, and stops with the activity.

tests.title: indeterminate activity uses the declared cadence: named period, linear, infinite
cadence stops when the represented activity stops
repeated cadence motion that never stops under reduced motion fails

requirements.behavior: Reduced motion substitutes per model: spatial motion collapses, repeated motion stops, direct manipulation is preserved, brief perceptual change may remain.

tests.title: reduced motion collapses inertial and gravity timing for every weight scope
reduced motion removes indicator travel and press compression but keeps selection
reduced motion stops repeated activity while text and busy semantics remain
reduced motion places items and panes directly at their final position
spatial motion without a reduced-motion substitution fails
a declared reduced-motion substitution must exist in the stylesheet

requirements.behavior: Rapid repeated activation retargets motion instead of queueing it.

tests.title: rapid keyboard selection retargets the indicator instead of queueing and semantics are immediate
rapid keyboard selection is immediate and does not queue motion

requirements.behavior: Semantic state is authoritative immediately; motion never gates it.

tests.title: button press state is immediate and non-spatial
pointer and touch-equivalent activation open the hint; state is immediate
opt-in View Transitions use perceptual crossfades and never gate the state update
a published value is authoritative and legible from the first frame; no count-through

requirements.behavior: Determinate progress is a direct projection that cannot overshoot.

tests.title: determinate progress is a direct projection that cannot overshoot
scroll-linked progress is a direct projection of scroll position

requirements.behavior: Direct manipulation tracks the authoritative value with no lag.

tests.title: the dragged item tracks the application-supplied offset with no lag
slider keeps native direct manipulation: only hover emphasis is transitioned

requirements.behavior: Rejected drops return to the authoritative position; resizing never leaves legal bounds.

tests.title: a rejected drop returns to its authoritative position with a non-color cue and no success
split-pane resizing tracks directly and never leaves legal bounds, even when settling
post-release settling is damped and never overshoots the authoritative position

requirements.behavior: Concurrent effects compose on independent properties and never clobber each other.

tests.title: concurrent press and selection motion compose without clobbering
the transform shorthand is rejected because it clobbers concurrent effects

requirements.behavior: Every progressive enhancement degrades to a correct static presentation.

tests.title: without anchor positioning the checked segment itself carries the selection
unsupported anchor positioning falls back to a correct static presentation
without intrinsic-size support the disclosure opens instantly and fully
scroll progress is absent without scroll timelines and under reduced motion

requirements.behavior: Color, opacity and dimming change by perceptual interpolation across core, assessment, marketing and site CSS.

tests.title: color and background changes use the shared perceptual timing
every assessment option family shares one perceptual selection response
marketing buttons and cards use perceptual interpolation without spatial hover
site buttons use the shared perceptual motion and never move on hover
overlay opacity and backdrop dimming use perceptual interpolation, not mass-derived timing
